about_the_game: This demo offers a first look at Bleakmoor House, featuring an earlier version of Level One from the original vision of the full game. Step into the haunting atmosphere and uncover the roots of the mystery in this standalone slice of the original concept. Some mechanics, visuals, and pacing may differ from the final release, offering players a raw glimpse into the foundation of the horror experience to come.
